question: Who was sworn in as the 47th President of the United States on 20 January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Donald Trump.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Donald J. Trump became the 47th President of the United States on 20 January 2025.
 
• He is the only U.S. President to win a non-consecutive second term (served 45th President earlier, 2017–2021).
 
• His Vice President in 2025 is J.D. Vance.
 
• Political Party: Republican Party.
 
• Defeated Joe Biden in the 2024 U.S. Presidential Election.
 
• His inauguration marked the second time he took oath as President.
 
• He succeeded Joe Biden (46th President).
 
• *Hence, the correct answer is *Donald Trump.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Joe Biden:**

 
 
• **Born:** November 20, 1942, in Scranton, Pennsylvania, United States.
 
• Joe Biden previously served as Vice President under Barack Obama for two terms from **2009 to 2017** and has had a long political career as a Senator from Delaware.
 
• As of October 2023, Joe Biden is the oldest serving President in U.S. history at **80 years old**.
 
 
 
• **Donald Trump:**
 
 
• **Born:** June 14, 1946, in Queens, New York.
 
• Served as the 45th President of the United States, focusing on policies like tax reform, deregulation, and "America First" initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Ron DeSantis:**
 
 
• **Born:** September 14, 1978, in Jacksonville, Florida.
 
• Known for conservative policies as the Governor of Florida, he has gained prominence as a Republican presidential hopeful for 2024.
 
 
 
• **Kamala Harris:**
 
 
• **Born:** October 20, 1964, in Oakland, California.
 
• She is the first female Vice President and the first person of South Asian and African American descent to hold the position.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Presidential Elections in the U.S.:**

 
 
• The President is elected every four years through a democratic process involving **Electoral College votes**, where each state is allocated a specific number of votes based on its population.
 
• The candidate needs to secure a majority of **270 out of 538 electoral votes** to win the presidency.
 
 
 
• **Inauguration Ceremony:**
 
 
• The inauguration takes place on **January 20** following the election year, where the President-elect takes the **Oath of Office** as prescribed in Article II, Section 1 of the U.S. Constitution.
 
• The Chief Justice of the United States usually administers the oath.
